summary: Osprey Acquisition Corp. III, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its IPO and concurrent private placement. On July 2, 2026, it sold 30,015,000 units at $10.00 each, including full over-allotment exercise, for gross proceeds of $300.15 million. Simultaneously, it completed a private placement of 747,000 units at $10.00 each to the underwriter and sponsor, raising $7.47 million. Net proceeds of $300.15 million were placed in trust for public shareholders. The units each consist of one Class A share and one-third of a redeemable warrant exercisable at $11.50 per share. This is a standard SPAC IPO filing; watch for the target announcement and shareholder vote.
